characters.prompt_summary: A distinguished Three Kingdoms era general with a weathered, battle-hardened face and a commanding presence. He wears heavy, ornate ancient Chinese armor paired with a flowing, tattered red cape.

locations.prompt_summary: A steep, treacherous mountain pass from the historical Three Kingdoms era. The landscape features jagged, rocky cliffs entirely covered in thick snow and ice. Violent mountain winds whip blinding snow and loose debris across the freezing, rugged terrain.
A high, steep cliff edge overlooking a vast, deep valley. The rugged descent path is framed by sheer rocky precipices. Far below, the sprawling footprint of an ancient walled city rests in the basin.

props.prompt_summary: A traditional Chinese general's halberd. It features a long, sturdy wooden shaft and a highly polished, curved metal blade at the top.
An ancient Chinese army banner mounted on a tall wooden pole. The thick fabric has heavily torn edges and displays a large, bold Chinese character painted in the center.
A massive traditional war drum used for commanding armies. It consists of a gigantic, reinforced wooden barrel with a tightly stretched, heavy leather top.

characters.prompt_summary: The general is caught in a harsh daylight blizzard. His ornate armor and tattered red cape are dusted with snow and blown intensely by the freezing mountain wind.

locations.prompt_summary: The jagged mountain pass is illuminated by harsh, diffused daytime sunlight cutting through thick snow flurries. Ferocious winds continuously whip blinding white powder across the steep, icy cliffs.

props.prompt_summary: The wooden shaft and curved metal blade of the halberd are frosted with a thin layer of ice. Harsh daylight catches the frozen condensation on the weapon.
The torn army banner is violently whipped around by the daytime mountain gale. Frost clings to the rugged fabric bearing the large Chinese character.

keyframes.prompt_summary: A sweeping wide shot of an ancient Chinese army struggling up a jagged, snow-swept mountain pass under harsh daylight. A torn army banner with a large Chinese character is blown violently by the freezing gale. The steep, icy cliffs dominate the treacherous landscape as the soldiers lean into the wind.
keyframes.video_motion_hint: The camera pans slowly across the struggling soldiers. Violent wind continuously whips the banner and drives thick snow horizontally through the frame.

keyframes.prompt_summary: A medium shot from a low angle of General Zhao marching forward through a fierce daytime blizzard. His heavy armor is caked with snow as he firmly plants his long, curved halberd into the icy ground to brace himself. His weathered face shows intense physical strain against the howling wind.
keyframes.video_motion_hint: General Zhao leans his heavy weight onto the halberd, bracing against a massive gust of wind. His tattered red cape forcefully flaps and snaps in the blizzard.

keyframes.prompt_summary: A medium shot at eye level focusing tightly on General Zhao's desperate, shouting face. He turns his head over his shoulder, holding his tall halberd, calling out to unseen troops. His snow-dusted armor and red cape are violently blown sideways by the relentless mountain gale.
keyframes.video_motion_hint: A slow push-in zoom on Zhao's face as he yells with urgent intensity. Thick white snow aggressively whips past his face in the foreground.

keyframes.prompt_summary: A medium tracking shot showing exhausted soldiers marching forward with renewed vigor, pushing past General Zhao who stands firm in the foreground. Large, torn army banners wave erratically in the blinding snowstorm. The harsh daylight casts deep shadows on the treacherous, icy terrain.
keyframes.video_motion_hint: The camera tracks alongside the moving soldiers as they trudge forward. They lean heavily against the wind while Zhao stands steadfast like an unmoving pillar.

characters.prompt_summary: The general is illuminated by the warm, flickering orange glow of distant fires against the pitch-black night. His red cape is heavily dusted with thick, unmelting snow.

locations.prompt_summary: The high cliff edge is engulfed in darkness, starkly illuminated from below by the intense, glowing orange light of thousands of siege fires burning in the deep valley.

props.prompt_summary: The halberd's curved metal blade heavily reflects the warm, flickering orange light of the distant burning city against the night sky.
The massive wooden war drum sits in the dark night. Its stretched leather top catches the ambient orange glow from the fiery valley below.

keyframes.prompt_summary: A high-angle wide shot looking over the shoulder of General Zhao as he stands at a snowy cliff edge at night. Far below in the deep, dark valley, a massive besieged ancient city burns brightly, radiating an intense orange glow. Thousands of tiny enemy campfires speckle the landscape surrounding the burning structures.
keyframes.video_motion_hint: Thick smoke drifts slowly upward from the burning city deep in the valley. Subtle, flickering firelight dances across Zhao's armor in the dark foreground.

keyframes.prompt_summary: A medium shot at eye level of General Zhao atop his warhorse in the darkness of the cliff. He holds his long, curved halberd high, the metal blade catching the fiery orange light from the valley below. His heavily snow-dusted red cape drapes over the saddle as he prepares to address his hidden army.
keyframes.video_motion_hint: The camera pans to follow Zhao as he sharply wheels his horse around. The horse snorts, sending visible puffs of breath into the freezing night air.

keyframes.prompt_summary: A dramatic close-up from a low angle of General Zhao's weathered face at night. The intense orange firelight from the valley reflects brightly in his fierce, wide eyes. He is shouting a furious command into the darkness, tightly gripping the wooden shaft of his halberd.
keyframes.video_motion_hint: Zhao's facial expression contorts with aggressive, booming fury as he shouts. The flickering firelight casts dynamic, shifting shadows across his determined features.

keyframes.prompt_summary: An extreme close-up of a massive wooden war drum at eye level in the dead of night. A heavy mallet forcefully impacts the tightly stretched leather drumhead. The sheer force of the strike kicks up a visible cloud of bright white snow around the instrument against the dark background.
keyframes.video_motion_hint: The heavy mallet strikes the drumhead violently, compressing the leather top. A burst of powdery white snow erupts outward from the impact zone into the night air.

keyframes.prompt_summary: A wide, low-angle tracking shot of a massive wave of ancient cavalry and infantry charging aggressively down a steep, snowy mountain slope. General Zhao leads the vanguard on horseback, his curved halberd raised high. The entire charging army is dramatically silhouetted against the roaring, orange glow of the burning besieged city in the background.
keyframes.video_motion_hint: The camera tracks rapidly backward as the tidal wave of soldiers and horses charges furiously down the slope. Snow kicks up intensely beneath the thundering hooves.

style_notes: Harsh, dramatic lighting emphasizing the treacherous journey
